families.cause: A resting object or handwritten centreline is reused as travel geometry without reserving its complete footprint and named reading surfaces. Reconstructed old coordinates can now touch a different victim, or no victim, after later layout changes.
families.construction: Keep the current scene-owned ports, purpose-sized token and footprint clearance. Select protected subjects from the authored explanation, then derive offsets from their actual geometry. Use existing clearRoute only where a genuine corridor is needed; do not route every drawing globally.
families.keeper: Poppy fidelity.ts journeys; Refusals scene.test.ts native routeInkCheck; SignIn scene.test.ts password/poll checks; Sessions oracle/fidelity.ts protected stamp body.
families.remaining: Retain exact subject identities in v2 and keep secondary clock/domain/object contact separate. No baseline route defect was observed in this review. The MCP old victim is absent from the valid first-refresh flight; its held-key refresh attempt is refused. Do not alter production to recreate that obsolete history.

families.cause: An omitted fresh/leave/lead beat is repaired only at c.rest(), so final pictures are correct while old context persists, a prerequisite arrives late, or a source copy remains during travel. Prefix lists also confuse transient results with persistent context.
families.construction: Use carry for physical transfers, pass for intentional copies, and explicit before-flight clearing for old pages/results. Keep contextual lanes out of fresh. Preserve event-specific motion present/absent rules independently of choreography.
families.keeper: MachineMotionCheck plus native Sessions handoff/source-bezel controls and explicit Poppy/Refusals/SignIn motion declarations.
families.remaining: Fix the demonstrated present-context compositing gap below. Preserve isolated physical-source absence, so hiding a duplicate behind a plate cannot satisfy retirement. Keep same-sign password reapproval classified as unreachable for the requested accepted log; do not weaken the model to film it.

families.cause: Same-key parts that merely change composition are left to c.rest() or lead morphs, which interpolates them into an invented journey.
families.construction: Keep the existing scene-local relaid endpoint crossfade and separately keyed MCP layouts. Movement purpose remains authored policy; a generic checker cannot infer protocol meaning.
families.keeper: SignIn scene.test.ts endpoint-only layout assertion; Refusals scene.test.ts lane-row endpoint checks.
families.remaining: Keep these as editorial constraints with positive travel controls. Do not lower generic jump thresholds to call a smooth layout slide a jump. An Exchange items/tag obstruction is a separately confirmed concrete finding.

families.cause: Declared event duration and authored beat sum are independent clocks; broad five-second limits cannot express a chapter-specific teaching budget. Later repairs changed the baseline duration, so old numerical comparisons can be stale.
families.construction: Keep Machine WhenItsTurnComes refusal when beats exceed event time. Measure approved chapter budgets on the actual reader clock, separating caption holds and frame bookkeeping.
families.keeper: explain/machine.ts duration guard; Sessions oracle/fidelity.ts pacing and durations.
families.remaining: Root is already repairing Sessions timing ownership. Keep squeezed prevention distinct from filmed defect diagnosis. SignIn 4.8 versus current 4.45 s and Sessions 4.35 versus 3.9 s remain explicit pacing policy, not a reason to lower the global five-second detector limit. The current SignIn 2.2 s ask is accepted, so do not claim a present overrun from its old name.

families.cause: A card is animated from a convenient desk coordinate rather than its explanatory source; generic geometry sees a legal journey and has no source semantics.
families.construction: Keep current agent presentation port above its actual key slot. Bind a named source/destination to this authored card transfer; use a scene-local assertion rather than infer origins from all drawings.
families.remaining: If an origin keeper is needed, add one local positive/inverse test: the first complete device card contributes native ink above the agent and a desk-start substitute fails the same source-phase assertion. This is a prevention gap; current baseline origin is correct.

families.cause: Scaling a detailed resting code slip preserves literal text at a size appropriate only to a wordless transit token.
families.construction: Keep the existing wordless codeToken rather than shrinking text or expanding a global legibility exception.
families.keeper: SignIn scene.test.ts wordless code transit assertion.
families.remaining: Strengthen only its witness: require actual composited moving code paint, not just opacity/points and two frame callbacks. Add a fully covered/offstage code challenge; the current test helper painted() can count a hidden object. Do not change the baseline token, which is already correct.

families.cause: Two independent products are issued concurrently from one shared port, causing their actual code/cookie ink to coincide.
families.construction: Keep current separate meaningful departure ports and sequential issuance. Parallel submission remains valid and must not be prohibited.
families.keeper: Browser scene.test.ts issuance ordering and motion declaration; current load sequence.
families.remaining: Keep one native overlap challenge on load, separate from valid paired submit. Avoid a generic ban on simultaneous travellers or overlapping boxes.

newCheckerGap.fix: Use actual scene minus exact subject composited contribution for required present; do not cache by isolated subject SVG alone. Keep isolated on-stage physical paint for absent retirement unless an explicit visibility-only contract is introduced.
